request.style: English, warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, cello, hopeful and gentle, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
LORD lead me in your righteousness
Make your way straight before me
There is nothing trustworthy in their mouth
Within them is destruction

[Verse]
Their throat is an open grave
With their tongues they flatter
Declare them guilty God
Let them fall by their own schemes

[Chorus]
But let all who take refuge in you rejoice
Let them sing for joy forever
Spread your shelter over them
Let those who love your name exult in you

[Verse]
For you have rebelled against him
Drive them out for their many transgressions
But the righteous find a steady rest
In the presence of the Lord

[Chorus]
But let all who take refuge in you rejoice
Let them sing for joy forever
Spread your shelter over them
Let those who love your name exult in you

[Bridge]
You surround them with favor
As with a shield
The blessing of the LORD rests
Upon the righteous heart

[Outro]
Sing for joy forever
Exult in you
